{

    "Use Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka as the service discovery backbone for U1 and U4; modules and xd-admin will register as Eureka clients.",

    "Configure CI (e.g., Jenkins or GitHub Actions) to perform incremental build/test on each commit, leveraging Maven/Gradle multi-module setup.",

      "activity_name": "U3: Capture Module Metrics via SI / SBoot Actuator",
      "activity_description": "Investigate Spring Integration channel-based metrics and Spring Boot Actuator metrics, wire module-level metrics capture in the module-launcher, and expose them through a dedicated REST-API endpoint decoupled from xd-container internals.",
      "most_likely_effort": 4.0

      "activity_name": "U4: Self-Register xd-admin with Eureka",
      "activity_description": "Add Eureka client configuration to the xd-admin server, ensure it self-registers on startup with a discoverable service name, and verify it can be discovered by other components.",

    },

      "activity_id": "A8",
      "activity_name": "U7: Persist Module Metrics (Redis via Actuator Export)",
      "activity_description": "Configure Spring Boot Actuator metrics export to Redis (default backend), set a configurable export interval (default 5s), and expose the persisted metric snapshots through a REST-API endpoint.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3.0
    },
